blocks.prompt: 7 If \(a^{2}, b^{2}\) and \(c^{2}\) are in A.P., show that \(a + b\), \(c + a\) and \(b + c\) are in H.P.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh proof wala sawal hai. Kisi bhi teen cheezon ko H.P. mein saabit karne ka asool: un ke reciprocals A.P. mein saabit kar do.
Yani dikhana hai ke \(\frac{1}{a + b}, \frac{1}{c + a}, \frac{1}{b + c}\) mein farq barabar hai.
Plan: dono farq (differences) alag alag nikalo, aur di hui baat \(a^{2}, b^{2}, c^{2}\) A.P. mein hain ko istemal kar ke unhein barabar dikhao.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a^{2}, b^{2}, c^{2}\) A.P. mein hain, is liye
\[b^{2} - a^{2} = c^{2} - b^{2}\]
Saabit karna hai: \(a + b, c + a, b + c\) H.P. mein hain (yeh jama zero nahi).
Tareeqa: Dikhayenge ke \(\frac{1}{c + a} - \frac{1}{a + b} = \frac{1}{b + c} - \frac{1}{c + a}\). A.P. ki pehchaan yahi barabar farq hai.

Pehla farq
\[\dfrac{1}{c + a} - \dfrac{1}{a + b}\]
\[= \dfrac{(a + b) - (c + a)}{(c + a)(a + b)}\]
\[= \dfrac{b - c}{(c + a)(a + b)}\]
Kyun: Do fractions minus karne ke liye common denominator lete hain. Upar \(a + b - c - a\) mein \(a\) kat jata hai aur \(b - c\) bachta hai.
Dhyan dein: Minus ke baad bracket khulte waqt \(c + a\) ke dono signs badalte hain.

Doosra farq
\[\dfrac{1}{b + c} - \dfrac{1}{c + a}\]
\[= \dfrac{(c + a) - (b + c)}{(b + c)(c + a)}\]
\[= \dfrac{a - b}{(b + c)(c + a)}\]
Kyun: Bilkul wahi tareeqa; is dafa \(c\) kat gaya.

Dono ko squares ke farq mein badlein
Maan lein \(D = (a + b)(b + c)(c + a)\) hai.
\[\dfrac{b - c}{(c + a)(a + b)} = \dfrac{(b - c)(b + c)}{D}\]
\[= \dfrac{b^{2} - c^{2}}{D}\]
\[\dfrac{a - b}{(b + c)(c + a)} = \dfrac{(a - b)(a + b)}{D}\]
\[= \dfrac{a^{2} - b^{2}}{D}\]
Kyun: Pehli fraction mein \((b + c)\) missing tha aur doosri mein \((a + b)\); upar neeche wahi multiply karne se value nahi badalti aur denominator dono ka ek ho jata hai. Upar \((b - c)(b + c) = b^{2} - c^{2}\) ka formula lag gaya. Yahi squares wo jagah hai jahan di hui baat kaam aayegi.

Di hui condition lagayein
\[b^{2} - a^{2} = c^{2} - b^{2}\]
\[\Rightarrow b^{2} - c^{2} = a^{2} - b^{2}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(-1\) se multiply kiya aur sides badal di. Ab dono fractions ke upar wale barabar hain aur neeche wale bhi barabar.

Nateeja
\[\dfrac{1}{c + a} - \dfrac{1}{a + b} = \dfrac{1}{b + c} - \dfrac{1}{c + a}\]
Kyun: Dono farq barabar nikle, to \(\frac{1}{a + b}, \frac{1}{c + a}, \frac{1}{b + c}\) A.P. mein hain, aur is liye \(a + b, c + a, b + c\) H.P. mein hain.

Tasdeeq numbers se: \(a = 1, b = 5, c = 7\) lein; \(1, 25, 49\) A.P. hai (har dafa 24). Ab \(a + b = 6\), \(c + a = 8\), \(b + c = 12\); reciprocals \(\frac{1}{6}, \frac{1}{8}, \frac{1}{12}\) mein har dafa \(-\frac{1}{24}\) ka farq hai \(\checkmark\).
Yaad rakhein: H.P. ulti tarteeb mein bhi H.P. hi rehti hai, is liye \(b + c, c + a, a + b\) likhein to bhi sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(a + b, \; c + a, \; b + c\) H.P. mein hain.
